name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router: Server Components, streaming, routing, data fetching/caching, Server Actions, SSR/SSG, and migration from Pages Router.

Choose Server Components for data, computation, secrets; Client Components for hooks, interactivity, browser APIs. Static = build time; Dynamic = request time; Streaming = progressive rendering. Start with Server Components; add 'use client' only when needed. Colocate fetching; use Suspense, parallel routes, Server Actions for mutations.

Route files: layout.tsx (shared UI), page.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx, route.ts, template.tsx, default.tsx, opengraph-image.tsx. Root layout provides metadata, fonts, providers, and HTML/body.

Examples/files:
- `app/layout.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`: async Server Component; `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })`.
- `app/products/page.tsx`, `components/products/ProductList.tsx`: await `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`; fetch colocated data with `next: { tags: ['products'] }`; render list/pagination.
- `components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`: client-side `useState`/`useTransition`; call `addToCart`.
- `app/actions/cart.ts`: `cookies()`; cart upsert; `revalidateTag`; validate checkout and `redirect`.
- `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`, `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`, `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/loading.tsx`: parallel `analytics` and `team` slots with independent loading.
- Intercepting photo modal: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx`; full page: `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx`; root layout accepts `modal`.
- `app/product/[id]/page.tsx`: block on product header; stream reviews/recommendations in separate Suspense boundaries.
- `app/api/products/route.ts`, `app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`: NextRequest/NextResponse GET/POST handlers; await promised params.
- `app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`: `generateMetadata`, `generateStaticParams`, `notFound()`.
- Cache: `cache: "no-store"` (fresh), `"force-cache"` (forever), `next: { revalidate: 60 }` (ISR), `next: { tags: ["products"] }`; invalidate with `revalidateTag`/`revalidatePath`.

**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore
